items.headline: $NIGHT Gains on $ZEC as Midnight Network Data Heats Up
items.summary: Fresh network data suggests Midnight's $NIGHT is closing the gap with Zcash ($ZEC). Privacy-season rotation could make $NIGHT one to watch early.

items.headline: $KAIA Forces Stakers to Migrate to New Contract Today
items.summary: Kaia is requiring public delegated staking users to manually migrate to a new contract, with a detailed guide dropping today. $KAIA holders should act fast.

items.headline: $JUP Adds Anchorage-Backed USDGO to $1B Lending Hub
items.summary: Jupiter integrates Anchorage-backed USDGO into its ~$1B Solana lending platform. The move deepens $JUP's DeFi moat as Solana lending heats up.

items.headline: Polymarket Launches Jensen Huang Affair Markets
items.summary: Polymarket rolled out serialized markets on whether media will report a fourth Jensen Huang affair participant, with 'No' trading at 54.5%. Peak 2026 prediction-market absurdity.

items.headline: Hoskinson: $ADA Is a Far Better Store of Value
items.summary: Charles Hoskinson argued Cardano is a superior store of value compared to rivals. $ADA faithful rallied behind the claim as alt sentiment resets.
